review: Sunshower Heathcliff is an awkward case. He loses SP on losing clashes and on Uptie 4 his S1 also applies sinking on him on Clash Lost, which is good, however, his sanity management is still tricky to play around. Uptie 4 did not help him much, outside of boosting his S2 when Heath is on -25 SP or lower. Unfortunately, Uptie 4 did not help much in terms of making him more rewarding to use and still requires a team built around him to function properly. Notable E.G.O. Synergies: AEDD - Solo fuels it and boost Sunshower Heath's survivability Ya Śūnyatā Tad Rūpam - Allows him to solo clear Mirror Dungeon with no issues that other IDs might have.
